column1: # Reconciled cipher runs of BnF fr.4140 f.247r (Sabran, "Advis particullier ... chasteau de Final", 1636) with the interlinear period gloss. FT4d (account-4), 3 Oct 2026.
# Passes: passA_f247.tsv, passB_f247.tsv (blind Opus, one crop set each). The worker settled the splits from the source crops (two zoomed views of bands L01, L05-L07):
#  Pc = the dotted looped sign with a C-curl below (A 'P', B 'E3^'), e.g. before x in "au"; 7d = the dotted 7-like sign after r in chasteau (A 'P', B 'p^'/'7^');
#  p = plain p (A 'p', B 'p^' where A reads plain p); E = the plain epsilon (both 'E3'). Where A 'P' faces B 'p^' and the crop was not zoomed, Pc is used when the gloss letter is a.
#  seg1 last E3^ (B) / E3 (A) = Pc (looped, C-curl; gloss 'final' wants a). seg9 split at the gloss boundary; A's 't ll E P x a Φ ll' kept (image: E and Pc both present, B dropped one).
#  seg10 final d (A) confirmed in the crop ("a f n u d au dessous"); seg6 d (A) kept by analogy.
# Excluded from the alignment (word codes or uncertain gloss, not letter runs): seg7-8 'les galeres et vaisseaux' (2-6 signs for 21 letters); seg12/18/25 'p l o t e ll e' (glossed bonet/bonec,
#  also unglossed: a cover name); seg16 Louan (7-8 signs, passes split); seg17 (gloss struck); seg19 (passes diverge); seg20 (first sign split); seg22 (gloss struck); seg23-24 'o i i o n' glossed
#  both 'biner' and 'La teyrie' (a code word, not letters).
